Change the `min_identity` in `from_mappy` to 0.80 (to reduce false positive) # Merge synonyms - We have multiple IS merge together, however, there is still few IS that doesn't merge ::: {#4bd54191 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd df = pd.read_csv("../../progress/result/new_merge_id/new_merge_id_report.tsv", sep="\t") # see if the synonyms merging was working print(df[(df["target"].str.startswith("IS1A", na=False)) & (df["context"] == "INSIDE")]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` locus_id target gene_id \ 45 locus_split_a13a8928 IS1A_IS1_unknown_stitched 1171599_2_173 46 locus_split_a13a8928 IS1A_IS1_unknown_stitched 1245138_99_444 47 locus_split_a13a8928 IS1A_IS1_unknown_stitched 1208153_0_267 49 locus_split_a13a8928 IS1A_IS1_unknown_stitched 1245038_99340_99433 57 locus_c482ac96 IS1A_IS1_unknown 1208153_0_267 291 locus_8639f554 IS1A_IS1_unknown 1245136_1_181 292 locus_8639f554 IS1A_IS1_unknown 1245136_225_444 296 locus_127d15b0 IS1A_IS1_unknown 1245138_99_444 context dist_bp topo_hops orientation effect copy_number \ 45 INSIDE 0 0 opposite strand NONE 3.0 46 INSIDE 0 0 same strand NONE 3.0 47 INSIDE 0 0 same strand NONE 3.0 49 INSIDE 0 0 same strand NONE 3.0 57 INSIDE 0 0 same strand NONE 3.0 291 INSIDE 0 0 same strand NONE 1.0 292 INSIDE 0 0 same strand NONE 1.0 296 INSIDE 0 0 same strand NONE 2.0 locus_contig locus_start locus_end coverage_pct 45 1171599|1245138|1208153|1245038 0 99436 48.4 46 1171599|1245138|1208153|1245038 0 99436 48.4 47 1171599|1245138|1208153|1245038 0 99436 48.4 49 1171599|1245138|1208153|1245038 0 99436 48.4 57 1208153 0 282 36.7 291 1245136 0 447 58.2 292 1245136 0 447 58.2 296 1245138 0 447 58.2 ``` ::: ::: There are: - 3 locus and 5 copies in total for IS1F (supposed to be only 2 copies) - 4 locus and 8 copies in total for IS1A (supposed to be 3) **This because after we stitched the IS together, the pipeline didn't removed the rest of the nodes which make a duplicate copies** ## Calculating the precision and recall Two comparisons against the truth BED: - **name only**: does eris find the IS at all? (copies ignored, each name counts once) - **with copy number**: eris copies = sum of `copy_number` over its loci (e.g. IS1A = 3 + 3 + 1 + 2 = 9); truth copies = how many times the IS is repeated in the BED (IS1A_1, IS1A_2, IS1A_3 = 3) Each is done without and with synonyms. With synonyms, names that ISfinder lists as synonyms/isoforms (e.g. IS30 / IS30D) count as the same IS, so a different name for the same element is not counted as a miss. ::: {#acba2440 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} from eris.synonyms import SynonymResolver, fetch_isfinder_table synonyms = SynonymResolver(fetch_isfinder_table()) loci = pd.read_csv("../result/new_merge_id/new_merge_id_report.tsv", sep="\t").drop_duplicates("locus_id") truth = pd.read_csv("../../data/ec958_IS.reannotated.sorted.bed", sep="\t", header=None)[3] truth = truth[truth.str.split("_").str[0] != "ISSen10"] # ISSen10 excluded from the truth set def is_name(name, use_synonyms): # IS1A_IS1_unknown_stitched / IS1A_2 -> IS1A; with synonyms, every synonym gets the same name return (synonyms.canonical(name) if use_synonyms else name).split("_")[0] def copies_per_is(use_synonyms): eris = loci.groupby(loci["target"].map(lambda n: is_name(n, use_synonyms)))["copy_number"].sum() real = truth.map(lambda n: is_name(n, use_synonyms)).value_counts() return pd.concat([real.rename("truth"), eris.rename("eris")], axis=1).fillna(0).astype(int) # IS where eris and the truth disagree (with synonyms) counts = copies_per_is(use_synonyms=True) counts[counts["truth"] != counts["eris"]] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: {#0ce8eee8 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} rows, errors = [], {} for use_synonyms in (False, True): counts = copies_per_is(use_synonyms) for mode in ("name only", "with copy number"): c = counts.clip(upper=1) if mode == "name only" else counts tp = c.min(axis=1).sum() fp = (c["eris"] - c["truth"]).clip(lower=0).sum() fn = (c["truth"] - c["eris"]).clip(lower=0).sum() precision, recall = tp / (tp + fp), tp / (tp + fn) rows.append({"Synonyms": use_synonyms, "Comparison": mode, "TP": tp, "FP": fp, "FN": fn, "Precision": round(precision, 3), "Recall": round(recall, 3), "F1": round(2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), 3)}) # Which IS are wrong: "FP 6" = eris has 6 too many, "FN 1" = eris misses 1 diff = c["eris"] - c["truth"] errors[(f"synonyms={use_synonyms}", mode)] = diff[diff != 0].map( lambda d: f"FP {d}" if d > 0 else f"FN {-d}") display(pd.DataFrame(rows)) pd.DataFrame(errors).fillna("").sort_index() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
